تبحبحتا (form IIq)
# تَبَحْبَحَتَا (tabaḥbaḥatā) /ta.baħ.ba.ħa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تُبُحْبِحَتَا (tubuḥbiḥatā) /tu.buħ.bi.ħa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
